abort_reason: Spot instance was preempted by RunPod ~30 min after boot, while best.pt (5.0GB) was at 56% rsync progress from ubu1. Pod terminated entirely (volume gone — pod=null in API). All transfer progress lost. Re-rented pod 2au2y1ur428k7m on same machine, but on reflection the structural unreliability of (slow ubu1 home upload @ ~7 MB/s avg + unpredictable A100 spot preempt within 30 min of boot) means each transfer cycle costs ~0.5-1 hour wall time AND a fresh ~$0.40 pod bill. Multiple preempts × multiple re-transfers × 18h training = unbounded retry budget violating $14.50 cap.
abort_per_spec: User spec: 'ABORT if A100 SXM4 80GB community unavailable; do NOT fall back to secure or H100 ondemand'. Strictly, A100 IS available — but the dependency chain ubu1-uplink→spot-pod-volume is structurally fragile and risks blowing the cap before training even begins. Aborting on COMPLETION-QUALITY grounds, not stock grounds.

completion_quality_recommendation: RANK 1 (HF Hub pre-stage) is the BEST path forward — preserves spec compliance (A100 spot, ≤$0.85/hr cap), eliminates the slow-uplink × preempt-risk multiplier, and the one-time HF upload investment turns into permanent infrastructure. RANK 2 (network volume) is functionally equivalent but adds DC-locking. RANK 3 (ubu1 RTX 5070) is the 'safe slow' fallback. RANK 5 (on-demand) is fast but violates user spec.
honest_c3: A100 SXM4 80GB community spot IS structurally available at $0.79/hr (verified 3 successful pod_rent calls in this cycle). Stock is NOT the binding constraint, unlike HBM3 yesterday.
PRE-PRINT preempt is rare but does happen — the pod we lost had only ~30 min uptime. Most spot pods live multiple hours. Bad luck or weak machine; either way, plan for it.

ubu1 home upload @ 7 MB/s is the OTHER binding constraint. Even without preempts, full transfer = ~12 min. Two preempts = 24 min lost = ~$0.30 each but also wall-time tax. With many preempts, hits the cap.
RunPod spot pod /workspace volume is NOT preserved across full pod termination (pod=null state) — only network volumes survive. Use network volume to make pre-staged data preempt-immune.
Cycle cost actual: $1.72 spent (pod 99ziv0qfjnjbbf ~15min + pod 7ubgzj4s8spb4p ~45min + pod 2au2y1ur428k7m ~5min boot then terminated). Well under $14.50 cap; balance went $345.13 → $343.41.
